mask_chunk_schedule: public runtime loops over independently keyed 64-bit words and batches of 64 records; canonical full-field decomposition per word
access_backend: secret-shared fixed scan; no data-dependent addresses
row_metadata: secret shuffle of complete DB rows, labels/tie tags included; all persistent shares refreshed
indexed_reference: fixed scan of all padded slots for every record, exact field equality, secret OR deduplication and secret certified fallback
baseline: stable full-128-bit radix sort/merge; no truncated sort keys; no quadratic pointer join as main comparator
limitations: all five parties on one host for measurement
logical atomic selection is separate from durable crash-atomic epoch publication
